amp_nontransfer_guidance.recommended_reframe: AMP-bound hydrolase/exonuclease/phosphatase cases should be treated as non-transfer states rather than strictly product states, because AMP can be substrate-state or product-state while still not being adenylyl-transfer evidence.
amp_nontransfer_guidance.scope_requirement: Only consider AMP within the M-CSA-annotated catalytic pocket, using proximity to annotated catalytic residues, to avoid allosteric or regulatory AMP false positives.

product_or_nontransfer_positive_examples.note: AMP may be substrate-state or product-state; either way it should suppress nucleotide-transfer counterevidence if catalytic-pocket context supports hydrolysis.
Hydrolytic cyclic nucleotide phosphodiester cleavage to AMP context.
Terminal phosphodiester hydrolysis to NMP/dNMP context.
RNA exonucleolytic hydrolysis to NMP context.

transfer_state_controls.note: aa-AMP intermediate; synthetic-site AMP is adenylyl-transfer evidence.
Autoadenylated ligase-AMP intermediate may lack PPi; check covalent AMP-Lys linkage.

transfer_state_controls.class: ANL adenylating enzymes / acyl-CoA synthetases / NRPS A-domains
transfer_state_controls.note: Acyl-AMP intermediate attacked by CoA-SH or carrier-protein thiol.
AMP transfer from ATP onto NMN; PPi leaving-group context.

transfer_state_controls.class: asparagine synthetase B or related ATP-dependent amide ligases
transfer_state_controls.note: Adenylated intermediate with later nucleophilic attack.

edge_cases_required_before_production.required_feature: covalent AMP-Lys linkage from AMP alpha phosphate to conserved Lys Nzeta

edge_cases_required_before_production.reason: Phosphoryl transfer involving AMP substrate/product, not adenylyl transfer.

edge_cases_required_before_production.required_feature: Distinguish bidentate Ap4A product geometry with two adenines around dimetal center from in-line AMP plus leaving-group geometry.
M-CSA per-residue site distinction between synthetic adenylation site and hydrolytic editing site.

if_amp_present_and_in_annotated_catalyti: If EC/fold supports 3.1.3.x, 3.1.4.x, 3.1.11.x, 3.1.13.x, or selected 3.6.1.x hydrolase context, and no transfer-state subrule fires, suppress nucleotide_transfer_ligand_context as non-transfer AMP context.

If EC/fold supports 2.7.7.x or 6.x adenylyl-transfer / adenylating context, retain nucleotide_transfer_ligand_context when PPi, in-line alpha-phosphate acceptor geometry, or covalent AMP-Lys autoadenylation evidence is present.
Route EC 2.7.4.x and non-catalytic regulatory AMP to out-of-scope or ambiguous rather than product/transfer classification.

scientific_name_candidates: B12-dependent aminomutases of the PLP class
coupled PLP-adenosylcobalamin aminomutase radical rearrangement motif
coupled_plp_cobalamin_guidance.reasoning: PLP forms the substrate Schiff base while adenosylcobalamin generates the 5'-deoxyadenosyl radical for H-atom abstraction. Both cofactors are mechanistically essential; collapsing to pure PLP or pure cobalamin loses mechanism-distinguishing spatial and electronic constraints.
minimal_evidence_required: Both PLP or LLP and adenosylcobalamin/B12 with 5'-deoxyadenosyl moiety present or otherwise explicitly supported by M-CSA mechanism evidence.
PLP-anchoring catalytic lysine annotated, forming internal or substrate Schiff-base chemistry.
AdoCbl-positioning catalytic residue annotated near cobalt or Co-C bond homolysis context.
M-CSA mechanism summary explicitly invokes both PLP-substrate aldimine and adenosylcobalamin-derived radical on the same substrate.
coupled_plp_cobalamin_guidance.implication_for_m_csa_737: Do not force m_csa:737 into pure cobalamin_radical_rearrangement or pure plp_dependent_enzyme. Keep review-only until a coupled multi-cofactor / multi-target schema exists.
